message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Plan phase complete (milestone 2). Branch: 001-transactions. IMPL_PLAN: /testbed/specs/001-transactions/plan.md (142 lines; setup_plan.py --json confirmed plan exists and returned FEATURE_SPEC/IMPL_PLAN/FEATURE_DIR/BRANCH). All design artifacts updated for the current frozen requirements (R01-R03 retained + Claim-A put-recency extension + R04/R05/R06 + Claim-A round-2 expiry clarification): (1) plan.md — Summary, Technical Context, and Phase 0/1 pointers extended with milestone-2 content and new observed codebase facts (Cache.maxsize is a read-only property over name-mangled __maxsize; LRUCache.popitem() is public LRU eviction; LRUCache.__iter__ is insertion order, not recency order — so reordering logic must use popitem()); (2) research.md (215 lines) — new R8 (invalidate_many: validate mode in {any,all} + tags with put-rules first; any=union, all=intersection over tag->set index; empty requested tags remove ZERO in both modes, explicitly superseding the old design note; distinct-key count; single code path via _remove), R9 (resize: validate positive non-bool int first; shrink via popitem()+_remove until fits; grow = capacity update only; failure = zero state change; maxsize property delegates to LRUCache.maxsize; rejected alternatives: rebuild-corrupts-order, upstream setter violates Principle I; risk note confined to tagged.py with mandatory tests), R10 (generator tags consumed exactly once via single list(iter(tags)) pass; detachment already guaranteed by deepcopy, R06 adds explicit tests); open items: none (round-2 expiry clarification recorded as assumption — no R07/R08 in frozen set, so no expiry attribute exists and resize preserves entry state as-is); (3) data-model.md (86 lines) — resize/invalidate_many state transitions, invariants 7-8 (post-resize capacity/order/no stale refs; empty-all-removes-zero), validation table extended (resize capacity, invalid mode/tags); (4) contracts/tagged-cache-api.md (112 lines) — invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'), resize(maxsize), maxsize property documented with full error contract and non-goals (no TTL/expiry); (5) quickstart.md (132 lines) — test coverage list extended for R04/R05/R06 and new scenario 5 (milestone-2 boundary spot-check script: any/all counts, empty-removes-zero both modes, invalid mode rejected, shrink/grow maxsize property, zero-resize rejected with state preserved). Constitution Check: gate result PASS (no violations; additive single-module design, no new dependencies, tests mandatory, risk items tracked). Evidence (observed): wc -l totals 687 lines across the 5 artifacts; grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' plan.md -> 0; git status --porcelain shows only untracked .specify/, TASK_STAGE_1.md, TASK_STAGE_2.md, acceptance_public.py, specs/ — zero modifications to tracked upstream files. No .specify/extensions.yml exists, so no hooks were checked or run. Ready for $speckit-tasks; implementation remains src/cachetools/tagged.py with acceptance_public.py as the public gate."}
